info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Unsettled Amounts API
Exchange Breakdown: Owed by Currency and Amount Type

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: The key of the account group to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The keys of the accounts to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AmountTypeSource
params.description: Specifies the response data granularity, providing access to source of AmountType.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: The key of the client to which the resource belongs.

params.name: ExchangeId
params.description: The exchange identifier for which value dated amounts is requested. If no exchange is associated to those amounts, use "NoExchange" as the value.

items.docs: For a specific Exchange Identifier, gets unsettled amounts for each currency and each underlying amount type.

info.name: Exchange Breakdown: Owed by Exchange and Currency

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: The key of the account group to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The keys of the accounts to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AmountTypeSource
params.description: Specifies the response data granularity, providing access to source of AmountType.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: The key of the client to which the resource belongs.

items.docs: Gets unsettled amounts grouped by exchange, for each currency owed by (or to) the requester.

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: The key of the account group to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The keys of the accounts to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AmountTypeId
params.description: Amount Type Id of the owed amount, for which you want instruments returned.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: The key of the client to which the resource belongs.

params.name: Currency
params.description: Currency code of the owed amount, for which you want instruments returned.

items.docs: For a specific Currency and AmountTypeId, gets unsettled amounts owed by (or to) the requester, for the underlying instruments.

info.name: Currency Breakdown: Owed by Currency and Amount Type

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: The key of the account group to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: The keys of the accounts to which the resource belongs.

params.name: AmountTypeSource
params.description: Specifies the response data granularity, providing access to source of AmountType.

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: The key of the client to which the resource belongs.

params.name: Scope
params.description: Specifies the response data granularity, providing access to either Currencies(default) or AmountTypes.

items.docs: Gets unsettled amounts for each currency owed by (or to) the requester. Scope can be extended in the request to include each currency's underlying amount types.
